jobs_results.description:
Overview

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Responsibilities

Perform SOX compliance testing, internal control reviews, and audit activities within agreed timelines.Demonstrate a strong understanding of SOX requirements, risk and control frameworks, and compliance standards.Execute control walkthroughs, testing, and documentation to assess control effectiveness.Identify control gaps, compliance issues, and process risks, and recommend corrective actions.Coordinate with process owners and stakeholders to obtain audit evidence and resolve findings.Track and support remediation of internal audit, SOX, and external audit observations.Perform root cause analysis and drive corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and internal controls.Support process improvement, automation, and governance initiatives to strengthen the control environment.Demonstrate strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.Exhibit ownership, accountability, and the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment.

Founded in 2016, Healing Himalayas Foundation aims to preserve the fragile ecosystem and cultural heritage of the Himalayan region. jobs_results.title: Accountant/ Accounts Executive
jobs_results.description: Position: Accountant Department: Accounts & Taxation Employment Type: Full-Time Location: Pilkhuwa, Uttar Pradesh Experience: 1–20 Years Qualification: B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter or equivalent We are looking for a responsible and detail-oriented Accountant to join our professional accounts and taxation team. The candidate will be responsible for day-to-day accounting, GST compliance, income tax-related work, reconciliations, and maintaining proper books of accounts for clients. Key ResponsibilitiesMaintain day-to-day books of accounts and accounting records. Pass accounting entries for sales, purchases, receipts, payments, expenses, journal entries, etc. Maintain cash book, bank book, ledger accounts and party accounts . Perform bank reconciliation and ledger reconciliation . Prepare and maintain sales and purchase registers. Assist in preparation and filing of GST Returns – GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9, etc. Perform GSTR-2B / purchase reconciliation and ITC reconciliation . Assist in Income Tax Return (ITR) preparation and filing . Assist in TDS return preparation, TDS reconciliation and related compliance . Work on Tally Prime / accounting software and maintain proper accounting data. Prepare Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheet and other financial statements . Assist in GST, Income Tax and Tax Audit work. Maintain proper documentation and supporting records for accounting and tax compliance. Coordinate with clients for required invoices, bank statements, purchase/sales details and other documents. Identify accounting discrepancies and assist in resolving reconciliation issues. Perform other accounting and taxation assignments as required by the firm. Required Skills Good knowledge of Tally Prime . Working knowledge of GST and GST Returns . Basic to good knowledge of Income Tax and TDS . Knowledge of MS Excel and Microsoft Office. Good understanding of accounting principles and journal entries. Strong knowledge of bank and ledger reconciliation . Good analytical and numerical skills. Accuracy and attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple client accounts and meet compliance deadlines. Good communication and coordination skills. Preferred Candidate 1–20 years of relevant accounting experience preferred. Candidates having experience in a CA Firm / Tax Consultancy / Accounting Firm will be preferred. Candidates with practical experience in GST, TDS, Income Tax and Tally will be given preference. Freshers with strong accounting fundamentals and willingness to learn may also be considered. Maintaining confidentiality of client financial and tax information. Salary: As per qualification, experience, skills and interview performance. How to Apply: Interested candidates may share their updated CV/Resume along with details of their qualification, experience and current/expected salary.
